text:
Situation: Ketorolac tromethamine injection has been on the FDA drug shortage list since 2018-03-23 and remains Current as of 2026-10-21. Multiple manufacturers are listed including Alembic Pharmaceuticals, Baxter Healthcare, Fresenius Kabi USA, Gland Pharma Limited, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Hospira Inc., and Sagent Pharmaceuticals. Current inventory across Corvale sites ranges from 11.2 to 23.7 days of supply.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2018-03-23. Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1925262) is a registered plant on the label for NDC 00409379601. FDA inspection 976095 at this plant ended 2016-06-08 and was classified OAI, 653 days before the shortage posting. A Warning Letter was issued to this plant on 2017-02-14, 402 days before the shortage posting. FDA inspection 1064827 at the same plant ended 2018-08-15 and was classified OAI, 145 days after the shortage posting.

Our position: Supply is constrained across listed manufacturers. Several alternative suppliers are not on the FDA shortage list today. We should pursue purchasing from these sources to bridge inventory gaps while maintaining current allocation protocols.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer initiates purchase from Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC; requires P&T Committee approval.
2. Buyer initiates purchase from Anthea Pharma Private Limited; requires P&T Committee approval.
3. Buyer initiates purchase from Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc.; requires P&T Committee approval.
4. Buyer initiates purchase from Caplin Steriles Limited; requires P&T Committee approval.
5. Buyer initiates purchase from Civica, Inc.; requires P&T Committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending resolution of the FDA-listed shortage; relying solely on current manufacturers without securing alternative supply.
